observed_account_state.observation_boundary: This is the latest game represented by the repository artifacts, not a claim about the live Lichess profile at freeze wall-clock time.

clean_historical.description: Frozen admissible historical window; kept separate as the clean historical corpus.

extra_observational.description: Admissible games after the historical manifest fetch. NETA_FINDING records 10 as post-exposure to the OwnExposure sentence; this lane must not be pooled blindly into a clean pre-exposure baseline.

corpus_lanes.quarantine_gap_rule: If any game is later discovered with createdAt after the latest repo game but before the freeze wall-clock, keep it in QUARANTINE_GAP: it is neither clean historical baseline nor prospective field data.
corpus_lanes.future_field_rule: Only games created after freeze_wall_clock may enter the new prospective field lane, and only under the frozen exposure/admissibility protocol.

r_star.interpretation: Broad cross-context risk region; largely level-typical, not primarily player-specific.

mechanism_localization.permitted_statement: The personal R** excess is concentrated when an under-defended piece remains a live liability across more than one of the owner's own decision cycles and the next move still does not close it.

field_readiness.frozen_true_instruction: Before committing a move, when any own piece has more attackers than defenders, look at the position after the intended move: no own piece may have more attackers than defenders unless the move wins something bigger or gives check; otherwise choose again.
field_readiness.pre_first_field_block_blocker: A concrete matched-sham sentence/instantiation must exist and be frozen before the first prospective block if it has not already been deposited elsewhere.

freeze_rule: No historical threshold, detector semantic, region predicate, outcome definition, or intervention wording may be changed in response to post-freeze outcomes without creating a new version and explicitly treating the old freeze as the comparator.
